description: Rare memento from the broodmother.

title: Compliance Badge

description: A badge from an ominent scientist, granting access to their specific department of work.

title: Defense Badge
summary: The Defense Badge is a tier 2 trinket found in a skeleton in the Haze Lab, in the back of the room full of Infected Weevils.
description: A badge from an Ominent scientist, granting access to their specific department of work.

title: Deuces Sign
summary: The Deuces Sign is a Tier 3 trinket.
description: A crude drawing of a boastful escape.

title: Entomologist Badge
summary: The Entomologist Badge is a Tier 2 Trinket in Grounded.
description: A badge from an ominent scientist, granting access to their specific department of work.

title: Everlasting Hogstopper
summary: The Everlasting Hogstopper is a Tier 3 Trinket in Grounded that, when equipped, provides passive generation for the player's hunger of 10 points per minute.
description: A source of infinite food. A nibble now and then satiates your hunger in just the right amounts.

title: Fancy Fletching
summary: The Fancy Fletching is a Tier 2 Trinket in Grounded that, when equipped, reduces the time of exhaustion when using a bow or crossbow by 75% for 5 seconds.
description: A mysterious feather that makes shooting arrows significantly less exhausting.

title: Fluffy Dandelion Tuft
summary: The Fluffy Dandelion Tuft is a Tier 2 Trinket in Grounded.
description: A fluffy puff of dandelion of exceptionally high quality. Could be used to drift down from even greater heights.

title: Fungal Charm
summary: The Fungal Charm is a tier 2 mid-to-late game trinket that can be obtained via harvesting Haze Fungus nodes with a 1% chance of being dropped.
description: A pretty growth of fungus that seems to want to protect you from harm.

title: Giddy Goop
summary: The Giddy Goop is a Tier 2 Trinket in Grounded that is obtained with a 1% chance from normal Fireflies or a 1/15 chance from stealing.
description: Mysteriously excited firefly goo ready to jump out at your foes.

title: Glowbasa Link
summary: The Glowbasa Link is a Tier 1 trinket whose recipe is obtained via offering the Infected Ant Queen a Moldy Hoagie once.
description: A stuffed link containing a randomized effect generated from deduper jelly to carry in your pockets.
urecipe: Offer A Moldy Hoagie To One Infected Ant Queen

title: Glowbasa Necklace
summary: The Glowbasa Necklace is a Tier 3 trinket whose recipe is obtained via offering three Infected Ant Queens a Moldy Hoagie.
description: Three stuffed links worn as a thick necklace containing a few randomized effects generated from deduper jelly.
urecipe: Offer A Moldy Hoagie To Three Infected Ant Queens

title: Glowbasa Wristband
summary: The Glowbasa Wristband is a Tier 2 trinket whose recipe is obtained via offering two Infected Ant Queens a Moldy Hoagie.
description: Two stuffed links worn as a wristband containing a couple randomized effect generated from deduper jelly.
urecipe: Offer A Moldy Hoagie To Two Infected Ant Queens

title: Health And Safety Badge
summary: The Health And Safety Badge is a tier 2 trinket located in a skeleton inside the Wasp Nest in the Brawny Boy Bin, found to the right of the eggs used to spawn the Wasp Queen boss.
description: A badge from an ominent scientist, granting access to their specific department of work.

title: Infected Broodmother Trinket
summary: The Infected Broodmother Trinket is a tier 3 Trinket, obtained as a 1% chance to normally drop or a 1/21 chance from stealing from the Infected Broodmother.
description: Extremely rare memento from the Infected Broodmother.

title: Insulating Larva Spike
summary: The Insulating Larva Spike is a tier 2 trinket that, when equipped, increases the player's resistance to sizzle damage in the Sandbox, BBQ Spill, and from Ladybird Larva attacks.
description: A larva spike that seems to absorb heat.

title: Intern Badge
summary: The Intern Badge is a tier 2 trinket found in a skeleton in the Upper Grasslands, in a small cave under the cap of the abandoned Milk Molar Bottle in the area.
description: A badge from an ominent scientist, granting access to their specific department of work.

title: Left Elf Charm
summary: The Left Elf Charm is a tier 2 trinket that is in a chest inside a Koi Pond outpost located just outside the Pond Dome.
description: A pebble village gossip elf reaches for something to the right. It feels important.

title: Mantis Trinket
summary: The Mantis Trinket is a Tier 3 Trinket in Grounded that, when equipped, causes the third hit of every combo will give a 2% increase to the players critical hit chance.
description: A rare and powerful memento from the mysterious mantis

title: Nifty Needle
summary: The Nifty Needle is a Tier 1 crafted Trinket in Grounded.
description: A very useful thistle needle that increases the damage of fully charged bow shots.

title: Power Droplet
summary: The Power Droplet is a tier 3 trinket the empowers the players unarmed attacks when equipped.
description: Tap into a hidden power, unleashing unarmed fury on your foes.

title: Pucker Charm
summary: The Pucker Charm is a Tier 3 Trinket in Grounded that, when equipped, applies 15 Sour damage to the player's attacks.
description: A condensed nugget of elemental force. Simply holding it fills you with power.

title: Right Elf Charm
summary: The Right Elf Charm is a tier 2 trinket that, when equipped, provides a chance to repair the player's weapon when attacking with it.
description: A pebble village gossip elf reaches for something to the left. It feels important.

title: Rotten Berry Charm
summary: The Rotten Berry Charm is a tier 3 trinket that, when equipped, gives Rotten Equipment a 20% chance to unleash a cloud of rot that Poisons targets, similar to the Mother Demon Armor's set bonus.
description: A piece of a grotesque berry that seems to bring out the innate power of rotten weapons.

title: Sarah's Charm
summary: Sarah's Charm is a craftable trinket that combines the effects from the Left Elf Charm and Right Elf Charm.
description: A reunited Pebble Village gossip elf hug charm. A shrunken keepsake of Sarah Tully. A powerful embrace combines the energy of both pieces in one.
urecipe: Discover Left Elf Charm or Right Elf Charm

title: Unstable Capacitor
summary: The Unstable Capacitor is a tier 3 trinket, that is obtained with a 5% chance from TAYZ.T participating in a raid.
description: Filled with electricity and ready to break free.

title: Valentine's Fortune
summary: The Valentine's Fortune is a Tier 2 Trinket in Grounded that, when equipped, gives the player 8 health for every Creature they kill.
description: A small piece of paper that inexplicably reveals your secret crush, received from a valentine's day chocolate. Grants a mysterious but chivalrous bonus.

title: Volatile Fang
summary: The Volatile Fang is a tier 3 trinket which has a 5% chance of being stolen from an Infected Wolf Spider via the Rascal Rogue mutation or the Sticky Fingers trinket.
description: The fang of an infected wolf spider that's ready to explode on command.

title: Wasp Queen Trinket
summary: The Wasp Queen Trinket is a Tier 3 Trinket in Grounded that, when equipped, gives a 30% chance for all bows/crossbows to not use up an arrow shot, effectively reusing it.
description: A rare and powerful memento of the elegant Wasp Queen.

title: Web Clippers
summary: The Web Clippers is a tier 1 trinket that can currently only be obtained in Playgrounds, and cannot be obtained in survival saves or using creative.
description: Doubles your damage against all web-based harvestables.

title: Wittle Widowling
summary: The Wittle Widowling is a tier 3 trinket found within webs in the corner of the Black Widows den in the Brawny Boy Bin.
description: An unusual piece of a black widow that seems to call out for its children.
